high_level_description: The image is a screenshot of an article from Inc42.com, titled "30 Startups To Watch: Startup..." The article discusses the journey of Mayan Kansal and Shivam Kaushik, who initially developed a D2C (Direct-to-Consumer) mobile app aimed at enhancing users' understanding and management of insurance policies. However, they soon realized that their tool was more impactful when used by insurance sellers. Recognizing this, the founders pivoted their focus to address challenges faced by insurance sellers. They founded InsurStaq.ai in 2022. The startup specializes in creating a generative AI
